records.rule: One AccountingBook belongs to one legal entity. Shared infrastructure and shared correlation never imply shared posting authority.
Normal operational integration emits authoritative AccountingEvent evidence; it does not start by manufacturing debit/credit lines.
Executable entity policy decides accounting treatment from authoritative evidence; Accounting Core enforces mechanics and evidence binding.
Check source identity/fingerprint before policy dispatch: exact replay returns DUPLICATE; changed reuse is a conflict.
Correlation connects independent company records for later reconciliation but grants no authority to post another entity's books.
An establishment/place of business is a scope of a legal entity, not automatically a separate company or intercompany counterparty.
Tax registration is an independent statutory relationship of the legal entity; do not infer it from domicile or require a fictional local company.
TaxRegistration is stable statutory identity; effective-dated TaxElection freezes exact ruleset, rounding, granularity and return-scheme identity.
Jurisdiction policy determines tax at high precision under the exact elected ruleset; the determination then enters ordinary accounting policy for GL treatment.
Tax rounding is a legal tax-policy decision applied to high-precision exact arithmetic; generic rounding primitives are not themselves tax law.
Settlement rounding begins from an already-accounted obligation, has explicit tender applicability, and never rewrites the tax amount.
Accounting money is exact whole minor units under NUMERIC DIGITS 50; unsupported width is rejected rather than rounded.
Durable books are append-only and preserve money/opaque identifiers as protected strings; recovery rebuilds replay identity as well as balances.
External statutory accounts are assessment evidence, never implicit native GL postings. Preserve mapping/evidence identity and omission semantics.
A statement intentionally not delivered is evidence of omission, not a zero and not permission to invent the missing detail.
Client-money arrangements retain establishment/regulator/currency/matter attribution, while substantive safeguarding rules remain regulator-specific policy.
A ReportingBoundary selects immutable journal evidence across exact scopes; it does not repost the book or redefine legal entities.
A sealed snapshot freezes exact source population. Later out-of-scope journals may leave it valid; later in-scope/backdated journals make the population stale without rewriting the snapshot.
Attestation binds the exact snapshot plus asserted authority/key identity; Accounting records the assertion but external authority/security/legal systems decide whether it was valid.
Corrections and regulator workflow are append-only lineage. New truth is added; prior accounting, reports, signatures, receipts and decisions are never rewritten.
Do not fabricate intercompany receivables/payables for activity between establishments of the same legal entity; preserve the relationship kind explicitly.
A journal may contain multiple currencies only when every currency balances independently; reporting aggregation never adds incompatible currencies.
Carry exotic legal/economic facts as evidence/dimensions and let versioned policy decide treatment; do not modify core double-entry mechanics to encode one structure.
A reporting boundary may span legal entities while every line keeps its original entity/book identity; that is not consolidation or elimination by fiat.
